fato_historico: 1970: Vietnam War: Lieutenant William Calley goes on trial for the My Lai Massacre.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to embrace deep empathy, Pisces. Much like the quiet transition from shadows into long-awaited light, you may find that healing comes from understanding the complexities of human history. It is a good time to release heavy burdens and focus on the gentle currents of grace that help wash away old, painful memories today.
frase_do_dia: True peace emerges when we choose kindness over the echoes of the past.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual wisdom and inner transformation.
conselho: Practice radical forgiveness and let your heart guide your healing journey today.
